gloss: to dissolve; to mix into a liquid

definitions.gloss: to dissolve; to mix (a powder or solid) into a liquid
definitions.explanation: To stir or blend a substance into liquid until it dissolves or forms a smooth mixture. Commonly used in cooking for mixing ingredients like flour, eggs, or seasonings into liquid.

examples.japanese: ⟦{味噌|みそ}→味噌：01037_miso⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{湯|ゆ}→湯：01740_yu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{溶|と}いて⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please dissolve the miso in the hot water.

examples.japanese: ⟦{小麦粉|こむぎこ}→小麦粉：04922_komugiko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{溶|と}いて⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{加|くわ}える→加える：01941_kuwaeru⟧。
examples.english: Dissolve the flour in water, then gradually add it to the pot.

notes:
A godan verb used primarily in cooking to describe mixing a powder, paste, or solid into a liquid. The transitive counterpart of ⟦{溶|と}ける→溶ける：02302_tokeru⟧ (to dissolve on its own).

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: Transitive (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧)
- Pair: ⟦{溶|と}ける→溶ける：02302_tokeru⟧ (intransitive — to dissolve, to melt)
- Pattern: X⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{溶|と}く, X⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{溶|と}く

ASPECT (ている):
- Type: Telic (has endpoint)
- {溶|と}いて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧: in the process of dissolving/mixing

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{卵|たまご}→卵：02222_tamago⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{溶|と}く: to beat eggs
- ⟦{味噌|みそ}→味噌：01037_miso⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{溶|と}く: to dissolve miso
- ⟦{小麦粉|こむぎこ}→小麦粉：04922_komugiko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{溶|と}く: to dissolve flour
- ⟦{絵|え}の{具|ぐ}→絵の具：16182_enogu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{溶|と}く: to dilute paint

NOTE ON HOMOPHONES:
Not to be confused with ⟦{解|と}く→解く：02301_toku⟧ (to solve, to untie) or ⟦{説|と}く→説く：14245_toku⟧ (to explain, to preach), which have the same reading but different meanings and kanji.
